question: What will be the maximum intraday value of the VIX over these biweekly periods in Q3 2026? (Sep 21 - Oct 2)

calls.reasoning: Spot VIX is ~15.4 after a post-FOMC vol crush from 17.71 (Fed hiked 25bp Sep 16, first since 2023, more signaled). The resolvable quantity is a MAXIMUM of intraday prints over 10 sessions, which sits well above spot even in calm tape: the reference-class median 10-session max/spot ratio from a 14-17 start is ~1.20, giving ~18.5-19. Adjusted modestly upward because spot is below its 50d (16.5) and 200d (18.4), the curve prices higher forward vol (Oct future 18.50, VIX3M 19.73), SKEW is elevated at ~146, the window is the seasonally weak post-September-opex stretch into early October, and Sep PCE, quarter-end and the Oct 2 payrolls print all land inside it. Offsetting: the biggest scheduled catalyst (FOMC) has passed, the Oct 1 shutdown risk was removed by the Sep 2 CR through Dec 11, and contango carry drags the front end lower absent a shock. Right tail is fat and real - a 15-16 spot preceded the Aug 2024 spike to 65 intraday by only a few sessions - so I price 1% above 50; a sub-10 print is mechanically impossible from here.

- Component fact: the VIX intraday high exceeds the same day's close by roughly 3-6% on a typical day, so a max-of-intraday series runs above a max-of-closes series.

EVIDENCE POINTING UP: hiking cycle re-started with more hikes signaled into a market that had priced cuts; SKEW elevated; VIX3M/VIX6M well above spot; spot below both its 50d and 200d MAs; post-opex plus late-September/early-October seasonality; payrolls on the final day; November midterms approaching.
